description: Inventory of the quality gates that exist in this repository. Every gate declares the single quality attribute it serves and, when applicable, which of that attribute's catalog tests it actually implements. This file is the only place where gate-to-attribute mapping lives; the coverage inventory and the evidence bundle are derived from it, never hardcoded.

coveragePolicy.note: An attribute is 'covered' when it has at least one gate and those gates implement at least strongCoverageMinRatio of the catalog tests declared for it; 'weak' when it has gates but implements less than that; 'uncovered' when no gate declares it.

vitest.note: Vitest gates partition a SINGLE `vitest run` into disjoint file sets. Every unit test file belongs to exactly one gate, so tests and assertions per attribute add up without double counting.

gates.name: TypeScript check
gates.description: Static type checking of the whole frontend, including the geospatial modules. Guards against type-level defects in GIS operations before any test runs.

gates.name: Spatial operations tests
gates.description: Unit tests of the H3 spatial operations: area computation against h3-js cellArea, tile-to-hexagon indexing with web-mercator tile math, parent-resolution rollup, and centroid/region derivation for the report.

gates.name: H3 boundary and geospatial constant tests
gates.description: Tests of the official IGAC boundary artifact and the derived territorial constants: polygon closure and vertex count, point-in-Colombia for the San Andres and Providencia archipelago, department coverage, and rejection of coordinates outside the territory.

gates.name: External geospatial service client tests
gates.description: Tests of the Nominatim geocoding client: request parameters, parsing of the returned GeoJSON geometry, MultiPolygon flattening into rings, and error propagation when the service answers with a non-ok status.

gates.name: Spatial data cache tests
gates.description: Tests of the client-side cache that keeps H3 datasets available between sessions: empty read, write-then-read, and replacement of a previous dataset.

gates.name: Health route test
gates.description: Test of the application liveness endpoint. Verifies the contract of /api/health only; it does not exercise any upstream spatial data source.

gates.name: Authentication and RBAC tests
gates.description: Tests of the Keycloak-backed authentication and role-based access control: route protection middleware for /dashboard, /admin and /dimensions, role extraction from the access and id tokens, refresh-failure handling, admin API handlers, and the guarantee that tokens never reach the client session.

gates.name: Dependency vulnerability audit
gates.description: npm audit over the production and development dependency tree. Records vulnerability counts by severity as evidence. Non-blocking on purpose: the current tree has known high and critical advisories, and blocking on them would stop all work on the pipeline itself.

gates.name: Cartographic UI component tests
gates.description: Tests of the components that present spatial information: heatmap legend and colour ramps, dimension and variable selectors, hexagon popups and tooltips, map search box, area display, and the prefeasibility report view, plus the contexts that hold their state.

gates.name: Accessibility tests
gates.description: axe-core accessibility audit over the public landing, the dashboard and the report screens. Fails on critical and serious violations.

gates.name: Map render performance budget
gates.description: End-to-end time-to-canvas budget for the dashboard map: the WebGL canvas must be painted within E2E_CANVAS_BUDGET_MS (30000 by default) with no uncaught page errors.

gates.name: Production build
gates.description: Next.js production build. Verifies the application can be compiled and served, including page data collection for the authenticated routes.

gates.name: CRS consistency and reproducibility tests
gates.description: Tests of the Web-Mercator tile to geographic bbox conversion used by the map grid against the independent OSM slippy-map formulas (round trips, shared tile edges, child partition), GeoJSON [lng, lat] axis order, agreement of the two 'inside Colombia' predicates, and order-independence/determinism of area, centroid, scores and the stored selection encoding.

gates.name: Spatial data source connectivity and fault tolerance tests
gates.description: Tests of the BFF proxy through which every tile, area and historial request reaches the private FastAPI data backend: forwarding of path, query, body and verified identity; 401 without contacting the source; controlled 503 when unconfigured and 502 when unreachable (connection refused, DNS, timeout); propagation of upstream 5xx; and stateless recovery once the backend is back.

gates.name: Backend fault injection and recovery tests
gates.description: Fault injection at the HTTP boundary (network error, 500, 503, hanging request cut by the 8 s probe timeout) against the global server-status banner and the report history: a single blip is tolerated, two consecutive faults show a polite non-blocking 'Reconectando' state, probes never stack, the history shows an explicit error with retry instead of an empty list, and both recover when the backend returns.

gates.name: Backend outage detection integration test
gates.description: End-to-end fault injection through the real Next route handlers: with the private FastAPI backend unreachable (BFF answers 502 for spatial data), the server-status banner must tell the user. Currently fails: the banner probes the Next-local /api/health route, which answers 200 regardless of the backend.

gates.name: Result reference values and topology tests
gates.description: Validation of the report figures against independent references: selected area of a drawn polygon versus the closed-form spherical area, convergence with resolution, additivity, centroid of a symmetric selection, turbine count and expected area for a capacity versus hand arithmetic; and topological consistency of polygon to H3 selection (no duplicates, no spill-over, no gaps, single component, partition along a shared edge, disjoint lossless compaction).

gates.name: Department attribution reference test
gates.description: Validation of the department shown in the report and used to name saved reports against a reference set: the capital of each of the 32 departments plus Bogota D.C. Currently fails for 13 of 33 references because the lookup uses overlapping hand-made bounding boxes.

gates.name: Report history traceability tests
gates.description: A report saved from the UI records the decision inputs (selection, active variables, project characteristics, report configuration), its outputs (area, region, scores) and an ISO timestamp; the stored selection decodes losslessly; re-running the analysis on the stored inputs reproduces the stored scores; opening it from the history restores the full state; and the history shows date, area, score and the data version only when recorded.

gates.name: Catalog and area data integration tests
gates.description: Integration of the two catalog endpoints (model and informative variables) into the live catalog with weights, metadata and the land/sea vocabulary; refusal to mix template and real data on a failing source; semantic consistency of master codes with dimensions and backend category/variable keys (separator- and case-insensitive, sub-variables averaged); and aggregation of multi-row area data into dimension scores and coarser map cells.

gates.name: Data origin and licence disclosure tests
gates.description: Every declared source link is a valid absolute http(s) URL with its source; the variable tooltip shows the declared source of every catalog variable that has one (linked when a URL exists) and invents none; the variable detail shows source, licence and link when declared and no licence otherwise; the report 'Fuentes de datos' sheet lists every source with version and link and the sources per dimension come from the variables' declared sources.
